description: Fit-critical artwork (a label someone reads to calibrate) whose thinnest stroke was not measured: nothing shows that it prints as drawn: blocker.

findings.fix: fit-critical artwork, such as a label someone reads to calibrate, must be shown to print as drawn: simplify it (fewer, smoother outlines; Inkscape: Path > Simplify, and no texture finer than the minimum feature) until its strokes are measured
findings.message: the thinnest stroke of the fit-critical artwork was not measured: the artwork is too detailed for the stroke estimate's work limit, so nothing shows that its strokes reach the 0.8 mm minimum feature of process `fdm-0.4`
